title: Amazing and fun Teambuilding workshop
text: Our team had an amazing time doing the Mosaic workshop! It was great fun, also in a larger group, and we are very pleased with our Mosaic Logo and will proudly display it in our office! Thank you again to the Mosaiccos team for making our Barcelona teambuilding event a success!
author: Sightseer65484803990

title: Entertaining and creative activity. Very funny!
text: A very entertaining, interesting and creative activity, while you are participating you are so focused that you disconnect from everything, super relaxing. 100% advisable in all areas, not just as a team building. Very funny!!
author: sandra f

title: A creative and very therapeutic teambuilding experience!!
text: A very relaxing, different and fun teambuilding activity that I would repeat! They treated us and taught us very well the tricks to make beautiful mosaics, top!
author: patil2017

title: A surprise, experience and outcome
text: I had never done mosaics, or trancadis in this case, and I was surprised by how entertaining and creative it is, how you quickly learn the technique of “controllably breaking” the tiles and the end result. A very pleasant time with my colleagues, although it does not give much time to talk, because it is a very laborious process. Angelika and her partner, I don’t remember the name, were lovely, guiding, but also letting experiment. A highly recommended experience.
author: DuchampVillion

title: Very fun and a very interesting Team Building activity
text: What I liked the most was the creative part and the quality of the material. The people who worked in the workshop are very friendly and professional and explain everything very well.
author: Sandra J

title: Perfect team building event
text: Really fun experience and very well organized. Perfect for companies! Angelika was very nice and helpful!
author: AaronRosenfelder

title: "Trencadis " and Beyond
text: Our companies Product, Design, and Engineering team enjoyed doing the “create mosaic company logo” activity as we learned about this Catalan handmade art and we produced something cool to showcase in our Barcelona office. Bonus: we also got to chat during it whereas sometimes other activities it is hard to chit-chat while doing them. Also, Angelika and her team were super nice, helpful, and prompt to give an extra hand to help finish the piece of art successfully giving all the guidance and tips needed!
author: in_sm783

title: Excellent
text:
A Unique Experience and a Very Good Possibility to Promote Team Building in a Work Mood.
Angelica is very professional, a true artist, who understands the needs of a corporate activity.
Everything was ready and well organized when the group of 40 people arrived. Each one had their work material and in teams of 5 people they set to work on creating logo.
Angelica was attentive to the needs of the group and accompanied the groups to ensure the success of the final work.
author: SEENetwork

title: A fabulous team building event
text:
24 of us went to Mosaiccos for a team building get together as part of a meeting whilst in Barcelona.
The session was fantastic and we created our company logo in 6 panels. The ladies were amazing and so calm and patient. 
We all had a great time. I thoroughly recommend this for both team building and all the family.
author: BigSally21
